description: Get an organization no market we cover lists, such as the U.S. Government, a federal agency or an unlisted company: its kind, country, LEI, parent and parts, the listed companies whose 10-K reports name it or one of its parts with the verbatim sentence, and for a federal agency the listed companies it awarded the most contract value in the last 12 months. Names from 10-K reports require the Pro plan.

maxResults.description: Maximum companies listed per side (default: 50, max: 500). A company and the parts listed under it are kept together.

organization.description: The organization's slug as GetSupplyChain prints it (e.g., us-government), or part of its name (e.g., Samsung).
